---
title: "Solar Panel Reliability Report"
output: html_document
params:
  stats: NULL
  bar_plot: NULL
  var_plot: NULL
  stat_s: NULL
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r summary_narrative, echo=FALSE}
library(gridExtra)

# Build summary table as a grob
tbl_plot <- build_summary_table_plot(params$stats) # returns ggtexttable (a grob)

# Prepare narrative as plain text grob
mttf_years <- params$stats$mttf_days / 365
lambda_yr  <- params$stats$failure_rate_per_year
n_total    <- if (!is.null(params$stats$n_total))  params$stats$n_total  else NA_integer_
n_failed   <- if (!is.null(params$stats$n_failed)) params$stats$n_failed else NA_integer_
surv10 <- 100 * exp(-lambda_yr * 10)
surv25 <- 100 * exp(-lambda_yr * 25)
# --- Add slope message if slope data provided ---
slope_msg <- ""
if (!is.null(var) && "slope" %in% names(var)) {
  if (sign(var$slope) == -1) {
    slope_msg <- "The control chart has a gradual decline or negative \n slope, suggesting decreasing average efficiency \n amongst the solar panels over time."
  } else if (sign(var$slope) == 1) {
    slope_msg <- "The control chart has a gradual incline or positive \n slope, suggesting increasing average efficiency \n amongst the solar panels over time."
  } else {
    slope_msg <- "The control chart has a neutral trend, suggesting no \n significant change in efficiency."
  }
}
  
bar_msg <- ""
if (!is.null(bar) && "top_failure_type" %in% names(bar)) {
  if (bar$top_failure_type == "Wiring") {
    bar_msg <- " Most of your failures are due to wiring issues. \n We recommend prioritizing electrical inspections \n and maintenance to prevent these failures."
  } else if (bar$top_failure_type== "Crack") {
    bar_msg <- " Most of your failures are due to cracking issues. \n We recommend replacing the part and contacting \n the panel supplier."
  } else if (bar$top_failure_type == "Wear") {
    bar_msg <- " Most of your failures are due to wear issues. \n We recommend contacting a maintenance crew."
  } else if (bar$top_failure_type == "Delamination") {
    bar_msg <- " Most of your failures are due to Delamination issues. \n We recommend replacing the part and consulting with the panel supplier."
  }
}

cc_msg <- ""
if (!is.null(var) && "xbar" %in% names(var)) {
  if (xbar > upper || xbar < lower) {
    cc_msg <- " According to the control chart, there are panels operating outside of maximum control limits of the average efficiency. \n Please check on the panels."
}

narrative_text <- paste0(
      "• The farm’s reliability was modeled using an exponential\n",
  " lifetime distribution.\n",
  "• The mean time to failure (MTTF) was estimated at ", sprintf("%.1f", mttf_years), " years (λ ≈ ",
  sprintf("%.4f", lambda_yr), " per year).\n",
  "With ", n_total, " panels and ", n_failed, " observed failures. \n",
  "• The model predicts\n",
  "      • ", sprintf("%.1f", surv10), "% after 10 years \n",
  "      • ", sprintf("%.1f", surv25), "% after 25 years \n",
  # add newline + bullet for each optional message
  if (nzchar(slope_msg)) paste0("• ", slope_msg, "\n") else "",
  if (nzchar(bar_msg))   paste0("• ", bar_msg,   "\n") else "",
  if (nzchar(cc_msg)) paste0("• ", cc_msg, "\n") else "",
  )

# Convert narrative to a text grob
narrative_grob <- grid::textGrob(narrative_text, x = 0, hjust = 0, gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 11))

# Arrange table and narrative side by side
gridExtra::grid.arrange(tbl_plot, narrative_grob, ncol = 2, widths = c(1, 1.2))
```

```{r life_plots, echo=FALSE}
life_plots <- build_life_plots(params$stats)
ggpubr::ggarrange(life_plots$pdf, life_plots$cdf, life_plots$surv, ncol = 3)
```
